the risk of type 2 diabetes is increased in individuals with a family history of diabetes, in those who are overweight or obese, and in individuals with a history of hypertension.

the development of new and improved methods for the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and disorders.
the development of novel, non-invasive methods for the early diagnosis of diabetes.

the use of HbA1C is a reliable tool in the diagnosis of diabetes, but it is not a substitute for the oral glucose tolerance test.

we are trying to identify the genetic basis for the development of type 2 diabetes.
